class.name: OcgBreptoolsTrsfmodification
class.brief_description: Describes a modification that uses a gp_Trsf to change the geometry of a shape. All functions return true and transform the geometry of the shape.
class.description: ! Describes a modification that uses a gp_Trsf to ! change the geometry of a shape. All functions return ! true and transform the geometry of the shape.

method.name: Trsf
method.description: Provides access to the gp_Trsf associated with this modification. The transformation can be changed.

method.name: IsCopyMesh
method.description: Sets a flag to indicate the need to copy mesh.

method.name: NewSurface
method.description: Returns true if the face F has been modified. If the face has been modified: - S is the new geometry of the face, - L is its new location, and - Tol is the new tolerance. RevWires is set to true when the modification reverses the normal of the surface (the wires have to be reversed). RevFace is set to true if the orientation of the modified face changes in the shells which contain it. For this class, RevFace returns true if the gp_Trsf associated with this modification is negative.

method.name: NewTriangulation
method.description: Returns true if the face has been modified according to changed triangulation. If the face has been modified: - T is a new triangulation on the face

method.name: NewPolygon
method.description: Returns true if the edge has been modified according to changed polygon. If the edge has been modified: - P is a new polygon

method.name: NewPolygonOnTriangulation
method.description: Returns true if the edge has been modified according to changed polygon on triangulation. If the edge has been modified: - P is a new polygon on triangulation

method.name: NewCurve
method.description: Always returns true indicating that the edge E is always modified. - C is the new geometric support of the edge, - L is the new location, and - Tol is the new tolerance.

method.name: NewPoint
method.description: Returns true if the vertex V has been modified. If the vertex has been modified: - P is the new geometry of the vertex, and - Tol is the new tolerance. If the vertex has not been modified this function returns false, and the values of P and Tol are not significant.

method.name: NewCurve2d
method.description: Returns true if the edge E has a new curve on surface on the face F. If a new curve exists: - C is the new geometric support of the edge, - L is the new location, and - Tol the new tolerance. If no new curve exists, this function returns false, and the values of C, L and Tol are not significant.

method.name: NewParameter
method.description: Returns true if the Vertex V has a new parameter on the edge E. If a new parameter exists: - P is the parameter, and - Tol is the new tolerance. If no new parameter exists, this function returns false, and the values of P and Tol are not significant.

method.name: Continuity
method.description: Returns the continuity of <NewE> between <NewF1> and <NewF2>.
